question: Hello! Odacchi! I've noticed something incredible!! About Mr. 2 Bon Kurei. Why Mr. 2 Bon Kurei has that codename! The men have a number, and the women have events... so Mr. 2 is the male part, and Bon Kurei (Bonkure, the end of the Bon festival.) is the female part, because he's an okama, right?
answer: That's right. The female agents' names are, in order, the happiest events of the year. So first; #0 is All-sunday (all sundays of the year). #1 is Doublefinger (New Years) #2 is Mr. 2 Bon Kurei (Bonkure) #3 is Golden Week (Golden Week, a week off in May.) #4 is Merry Christmas ...and that's how it works. I seem to have confused everyone with Double-finger.
